title: Redux Toolkit and Zustand
description: Conventions for Redux Toolkit and Zustand.

rules.title: Server state elsewhere
rules.text: Keep server data in a data-fetching cache, not in global client state.

rules.title: Small slices
rules.text: Keep stores small and organized by feature with colocated selectors.

rules.title: Select narrowly
rules.text: Select only the fields a component needs to avoid extra re-renders.

rules.title: Immutable updates
rules.text: Update state immutably; use Redux Toolkit or immer helpers rather than manual copying.

rules.title: Do not store derived data
rules.text: Compute derived values in selectors instead of storing them.
